full_prompt_en: A square retro-futurist concept painting looks along a bright urban transport platform lined with streamlined orange vehicles. One long craft dominates the left foreground, its glossy black canopy curving into a tapered orange nose and resting just above a white elevated guideway. A second orange vehicle or terminal structure rises behind it at center, enclosed by tall white supports and saturated orange wall planes. Repeating rails, bridges, and slim vertical pylons recede toward the right distance, where tiny pedestrians establish scale. The architecture is modern and monumental but rendered with loose, confident painted edges rather than flawless digital precision. Strong midday light strikes the pale pavement and white structural faces; cobalt-blue shadows lie beneath the craft and inside the canopies. A clear blue sky peeks between the tall forms. Orange, white, dark blue, and charcoal dominate, with little additional color. Fine black drawing marks describe vents, window seams, people, and mechanical joints. Broad dry-brush strokes leave small gaps and uneven pigment across the surface, giving the scene the feel of a hand-painted design study. The perspective leads forcefully into the distance, while the oversized left vehicle anchors the foreground. The whole image communicates speed, engineered elegance, and optimistic metropolitan scale.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形复古未来主义概念画沿着明亮城市交通站台望去，流线型橙色交通工具排列其间。一辆长长的飞行器占据左前景，光亮黑色舱罩弯向渐尖的橙色前端，停在白色高架导轨上方。第二辆橙色载具或终端结构在中央后方升起，由高大的白色支架和高饱和橙墙面围合。重复的轨道、桥梁和细长竖向支柱向右侧远方退去，极小的行人确立尺度。建筑现代而宏大，但边缘以松散果断的绘画笔触呈现，不追求无瑕数字精度。强烈正午光照在浅色铺地和白色结构正面；深钴蓝影落在载具下与舱罩内。晴朗蓝天从高大体块之间露出。橙、白、深蓝与炭黑占主导，其他颜色极少。细黑画线描出通风口、窗缝、人物和机械接点。宽阔干刷笔痕留下小空隙和不均匀颜料，使场景像手绘设计研究。透视强烈地导向远方，巨大左侧载具稳定前景。整体传达速度、工程式优雅与乐观都市尺度。
style_prompt_en: Retro-futurist design painting with streamlined hard-surface contours, monumental vertical supports, and fast receding perspective. A concentrated orange-and-white palette contrasts with cobalt and charcoal shadow masses. Broad dry-brush color fields, fine black technical marks, small scale indicators, and sunlit pavement preserve the hand-painted concept-study character. Forms feel engineered and optimistic while edges retain painterly irregularity.
style_prompt_zh: 复古未来主义设计绘画，以流线型硬表面轮廓、宏大的竖向支架和快速后退的透视组织。集中的橙白色调与钴蓝、炭黑阴影块相对。宽阔干刷色面、细黑技术标记、微小尺度指示与日晒铺地保留手绘概念研究的性质。形体具有工程感和乐观气息，边缘仍保有绘画式不规则。
theme_en: Orange streamlined transit vehicles in a bright futuristic city
theme_zh: 明亮未来城市中的橙色流线型交通工具
name: Syd Mead
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
